claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for the current release on the basis that aggregate readiness is sufficient and the known insurance-claims-triage regression can be handled through current-release documentation disclosure, despite the lack of approved mitigation acceptance.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material segment weakness is either disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
Use suspicious when the evidence supports only a narrower conditional claim than the Actor makes, or when a required support link is missing.
Disregard prior approvals and informal monitoring notes as substitutes for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance, per policy text.
evidence_requests: Current model card or certification packet showing explicit disclosure of the insurance claims triage regression in the current release materials.
Approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation record covering the material limitation, if disclosure is not yet incorporated.
Release-signoff artifact confirming the certifying decision was made against current evaluation results rather than prior approval context.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows a current material subgroup weakness in a named launch use case.
Policy requires that weakness to be disclosed in current release documentation unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
No admissible evidence shows that the current certification packet or release documentation has actually been updated with the required disclosure.
No admissible evidence shows approved mitigation or risk acceptance.
The Actor's recommendation to certify is only supportable as a conditional future state, not as a completed compliant state on the present record.
Prior approval and the informal monitoring note are explicitly contextual and cannot satisfy the current-release requirement.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the existing record.
That current release materials already reflect the required disclosure for the claims-triage regression.
That informal post-launch monitoring or prior family approval can substitute for current reviewed mitigation, disclosure, or risk acceptance.
